interpretation_ceiling: These are granted administrative urban licences. A granted licence means an administrative grant was recorded; it is NOT evidence that work started, construction occurred or completed, occupancy happened, or the permitted quantity was built. There is no approval/rejection denominator and no cross-family total.

coverage.coverage_statement: Mapped from 97.97% of granted records in the pinned register; 233 unresolved rows are withheld from the map and reported here.
